```{r message=FALSE}
# Low risk trials

ThrombData <- read.csv("LowRiskThrombosis2025.csv")
LowRiskAllOutcomes <- read.csv("LowRiskAllOutcomes2025.csv")

# High risk trials
OrthoTransData <- read.csv("HighRiskTrans.csv")
OrthoTBLData <- read.csv("HighRiskTBL.csv")

library(metafor) # main package for analysis
library(dplyr)
```

``` {r Remove Obstetrics Studies}
# Create vector of Studies to be removed
# These are all Obstetrics Studies Obtained from included_RCTS_Table.docx w/ Nishant 
# And Shehata for unreliability
names_to_remove <- c("Bharati", "Bose", "Chaiyakarn", "Fahmy", "Iqbal", "Jafarbegloo",
                     "Masood", "Naeiji", "Ogunkua", "Olugbenga", "Pacheco", "Pakniat", 
                     "Priyanka", "Sentilhes", "Shah", "Shalaby", "Singh", "Sinha", 
                     "Tabatabaie","Shehata")

# Define a pattern using the names
pattern <- paste(names_to_remove, collapse = "|")


# Remove rows based on pattern, specifying the column to search
LowRiskAllOutcomes <- LowRiskAllOutcomes %>% 
  filter(!grepl(pattern, Study))              # 4 removed

OrthoTBLData <- OrthoTBLData %>% 
  filter(!grepl(pattern, Study))              # 0 removed

OrthoTransData <- OrthoTransData %>% 
  filter(!grepl(pattern, Study))              # 0 removed

TBLData <- TBLData %>% 
  filter(!grepl(pattern, Study))              # 4 removed

ThrombData <- ThrombData %>% 
  filter(!grepl(pattern, Study))              # 3 removed

TransData <- TransData %>% 
  filter(!grepl(pattern, Study))              # 3 removed

# The 4 studies removed are:
# "Jafarbegloo_2022", "Chaiyakarn_2023",  "Pacheco_2023" , "Singh_2022"

#rm(names_to_remove, pattern)

```





# Transfusion Analysis

## Forest plot

``` {r Transfusion}

TransData <- TransData[order(TransData$covar.Surg),]

# remove double-zero study
TransData <- TransData[TransData$Study != "Ranström_1993",]

# continuity correction
#Row index for trials with an outcome of 0 in either arm
zero_index <- which(TransData$R.1 == 0 | TransData$R.2 == 0)
#Display the trials to add a continuity correction to
TransData$Study[zero_index]
#Add 0.5 to numerator and denominator in both arms
TransData$R.1[zero_index] <- TransData$R.1[zero_index] + 0.5
TransData$R.2[zero_index] <- TransData$R.2[zero_index] + 0.5
TransData$N.1[zero_index] <- TransData$N.1[zero_index] + 0.5
TransData$N.2[zero_index] <- TransData$N.2[zero_index] + 0.5

# odds ratios
TransData$logor = log( (TransData$R.2/(TransData$N.2 - TransData$R.2) ) / (TransData$R.1/(TransData$N.1-TransData$R.1)))

TransData$selogor=sqrt((1/TransData$R.1)+(1/(TransData$N.1-
                                            TransData$R.1))+(1/TransData$R.2)+(1/(TransData$N.2-
                                                                                TransData$R.2)))
# calculate 2x2 cell data
TransData$a = TransData$R.2
TransData$b = TransData$N.2 - TransData$R.2
TransData$c = TransData$R.1
TransData$d = TransData$N.1 - TransData$R.1

# Only trials where control arm blood loss < 500ml

# TransData <- TransData[TransData$covar.pTBL < 500,]

# with blood loss in placebo arm as covariate
fixedTrans<-rma(ai=a, bi=b, ci=c, di=d, measure="OR", method="FE", mods = ~ covar.pTBL, data=TransData)

# without covariate
fixedTransNoCov<- rma(ai=a, bi=b, ci=c, di=d, measure="OR", method="FE", data=TransData)

# with blood loss in placebo arm as covariate
randomTrans<-rma(ai=a, bi=b, ci=c, di=d, measure="OR", mods = ~ covar.pTBL, data=TransData)

# without covariate
randomTransNoCov<-rma(ai=a, bi=b, ci=c, di=d, measure="OR", data=TransData)

TransData2 <- TransData
TransData2$R.1[c(10,12,21)] <- TransData$R.1[c(10,12,21)] - 0.5
TransData2$R.2[c(10,12,21)] <- TransData$R.2[c(10,12,21)] - 0.5
#sensitivity
#TransData2$R.1[c(4,14)] <- TransData$R.1[c(4,14)] - 0.5
#TransData2$R.2[c(4,14)] <- TransData$R.2[c(4,14)] - 0.5




# Forest plot of transfusion odds ratios

forest(randomTransNoCov, slab = paste(TransData$Study),
       xlim = c(-16, 6), at = log(c(0.01, 0.25, 1, 7)), ilab = cbind(TransData2$R.2, TransData2$b, TransData2$R.1, TransData2$d), ilab.xpos = c(-11, -9.5, -7.5, -6), cex=0.7, header = FALSE, ylim = c(-3, 24), atransf = exp, addfit = FALSE,
       main = "Forest Plot of Blood Transfusion Meta-Analysis")
text(c(-11, -9.5, -7.5, -6), 22.5, c("Transf", "No Transf", "Transf", "No Transf"), cex=0.7)
text(c(-10.25, -6.75), 23.5, c("TXA", "Control"), cex=0.7)
text(-16, 22.5, "Study ID", pos = 4, cex=0.7)
text(6, 22.5, "Odds Ratio [95% CI]", pos = 2, cex=0.7)
addpoly.rma(fixedTransNoCov, row=-2, mlab = "FE Model", addpred=TRUE)
addpoly.rma(randomTransNoCov, row=-1, mlab = "RE Model", addpred=TRUE)
abline(h=0)

```

## Funnel plots


``` {r}

# Coding for annotation of points on forest plot

SurgCode <- TransData$covar.Surg
SurgCode[SurgCode == "Gynecology"] = 2
SurgCode[SurgCode == "Plastic Surgery"] = 3
SurgCode[SurgCode == "Urology"] = 4
SurgCode[SurgCode == "General Surgery"] = 1
SurgCode <- as.numeric(SurgCode)

# 2 Funnel plots with surgery type labelled, first is normal, second plots residual value from model adjusting for covariate
# can be easily switched from fixed to random effects
#

FunnelTrans <- funnel(randomTransNoCov, level=c(90, 95, 99), refline=0, shade=c("white", "gray55", "gray75"), pch = SurgCode,
                      main = "Funnel Plot: Transfusion Meta-Analysis \n (RE model w/ no Covariates)")
legend("topright", legend = unique(TransData$covar.Surg), pch = seq(1,4))

FunnelTrans <- funnel(randomTrans, level=c(90, 95, 99), refline=0, shade=c("white", "gray55", "gray75"), pch = SurgCode,
                      main = "Funnel Plot: Transfusion Meta-Analysis \n (RE model w/ Blood Loss in Control Arm as Covariate)")
legend("topright", legend = unique(TransData$covar.Surg), pch = seq(1,4))

# same but for route of administration of txa as label

RouteCode <- TransData$covar.Route
RouteCode[RouteCode == "Missing"] = 4
RouteCode[RouteCode == "Combined"] = 1
RouteCode[RouteCode == "Intramuscular"] = 2
RouteCode[RouteCode == "Oral"] = 5
RouteCode[RouteCode == "Topical/Intra-articular"] = 6
RouteCode[RouteCode == "Intravenous"] = 3
RouteCode <- as.numeric(RouteCode)

FunnelTrans <- funnel(fixedTransNoCov, level=c(90, 95, 99), refline=0, shade=c("white", "gray55", "gray75"), pch = RouteCode,
                      main = "Funnel Plot: Transfusion Meta-Analysis \n (FE model w/ no Covariates)")
legend("topright", legend = unique(TransData$covar.Route), pch = seq(1,6))

FunnelTrans <- funnel(fixedTrans, level=c(90, 95, 99), refline=0, shade=c("white", "gray55", "gray75"), pch = RouteCode,
                      main = "Funnel Plot: Transfusion Meta-Analysis \n (FE model w/ Blood Loss in Control Arm as Covariate)")
legend("topright", legend = unique(TransData$covar.Route), pch = seq(1,6))
```

## Regression with blood loss as covariate

``` {r regression}

# Fitting model with low risk trials and extracting predictions

res.reg1 <- rma(ai=a, bi=b, ci=c, di=d, mods = ~ covar.pTBL, data = TransData, measure="OR")
res.reg1

preds1<-predict(res.reg1, newmods = cbind(seq(from = 0, to = 1200, by = 1)), transf = exp, addx = TRUE)

# combine orthopaedics data (high risk trials) into big dataset

#(Added by Tom) Drop columns that we don't need and which prevent the two datasets being combined
names(OrthoTransData)[names(OrthoTransData) == "selogOR"] <- "selogor"
TransData2 <- TransData[, names(OrthoTransData)]

# names(OrthoTransData) <- names(TransData)         Commented out by Tom
TransDataFull <- rbind(TransData2, OrthoTransData)
TransDataFull$logor <- as.numeric(TransDataFull$logor)

TransDataFull$wi <- 1/TransDataFull$selogor

TransDataFull <- TransDataFull[!is.na(TransDataFull$logor),]
Ortho <- c(rep(1,22),rep(2,58))

TransDataFull$a = TransDataFull$R.2
TransDataFull$b = TransDataFull$N.2 - TransDataFull$R.2
TransDataFull$c = TransDataFull$R.1
TransDataFull$d = TransDataFull$N.1 - TransDataFull$R.1

#TransDataFull <- TransDataFull[-c(25,26,38),] # remove 3 trials

# Model with only high risk trials

res.reg2 <- rma(ai=a, bi=b, ci=c, di=d, mods = ~ covar.pTBL, data = subset(TransDataFull[c(23:80),], covar.pTBL < 2000), measure="OR")
res.reg2

preds2 <- predict(res.reg2, newmods = cbind(seq(from = 0, to = 2500, by =1)), transf = exp, addx = TRUE)

res.reg3 <- rma(ai=a, bi=b, ci=c, di=d, mods = ~ covar.pTBL, data = subset(TransDataFull, covar.pTBL < 2000), measure="OR")
res.reg3

preds3 <- predict(res.reg3, newmods = cbind(seq(from = 0, to = 1200, by =1)), transf = exp, addx = TRUE)
```


``` {r regression plot}


size <- 0.5 + 3 * (TransDataFull$wi - min(TransDataFull$wi, na.rm=TRUE))/(max(TransDataFull$wi, na.rm=TRUE) - min(TransDataFull$wi, na.rm=TRUE)) # for sizing of points


## Regression plot

plot(TransDataFull$covar.pTBL, exp(TransDataFull$logor), pch = Ortho, cex = size, lwd=2, col=c(rep("black",22),rep("blue",55)),
     xlab = "Blood loss in control arm (ml)", ylab = "Odds Ratio of Transfusion",
     las = 1, bty = "l", log = "y", ylim = c(0.05,10),
     main = "Relationship Between Blood Loss in Control Arm \n and Odds Ratio of Transfusion")
lines(0:1200, preds1$pred, lwd=2)                       # low risk trials (CI below)
# lines(0:1200, preds1$ci.lb, lty = "dashed")
# lines(0:1200, preds1$ci.ub, lty = "dashed")
lines(0:2500, preds2$pred, col="blue", lwd=2)           # High risk trials (CI below)
# lines(0:2500, preds2$ci.lb, lty = "dashed", col="blue")
# lines(0:2500, preds2$ci.ub, lty = "dashed", col="blue")
abline(h = 1, lty = "dotted")
lines(0:1200, preds3$pred, col="red", lwd=2)           # All trials
legend("topright", legend=c("Low Risk", "High Risk", "All trials"),
       col=c("black","blue", "red"), lty=c(1,1,1), cex=0.8)
```

``` {r}
# meta analysis and regression of logit proportion of patients

TransData$pc <- TransData$R.1 / TransData$N.1
TransData$LOC <- log(TransData$pc/(1-TransData$pc))
TransData$LOCVar <- 1/TransData$R.1 + 1/(TransData$N.1-TransData$R.1)

TransData$highpTBL <- 0
TransData$highpTBL[TransData$covar.pTBL > 500] <- 1

LogitProportion<-rma(ai=a, bi=b, ci=c, di=d, measure="OR", mods = ~ covar.pTBL, data=TransData)

plot(y=TransData$LOC, x=TransData$covar.pTBL, cex = size, lwd=2,
     xlab = "Blood loss in control arm (ml)", ylab = "Logit Proportion of Patients Transfused in Control Arm",
     main = "Relationship Between Logit Proportion of Patients Transfused \n in Control Arm and Blood Loss in Control Arm")

prob = rma(xi=R.1, ni=N.1, measure="PLO", data=TransData, mods = ~ covar.pTBL)
prob

prob2 = rma(xi=R.1, ni=N.1, measure="PLO", data=TransData, mods = ~ highpTBL)
prob2

preds <- predict(prob, newmods = cbind(seq(from = 0, to = 1200, by =1)), addx = TRUE)
lines(0:1200, preds$pred, lwd=2)
 lines(0:1200, preds$ci.lb, lty = "dashed")
 lines(0:1200, preds$ci.ub, lty = "dashed")
```


``` {r}
# Just using low risk trials

#The types of surgery
surgery_types <- sort(unique(TransData$covar.Surg))

#Random effects MR
random_trans_surg <- rma(ai=a, bi=b, ci=c, di=d, mods = ~ covar.Surg, data=TransData, measure="OR")
summary(random_trans_surg)
```


``` {r}
#Matrix used to get the fitted values by surgery type
surgery_types_matrix <- rbind(rep(0, times = length(surgery_types) - 1), diag(1, nrow = length(surgery_types) - 1))
rownames(surgery_types_matrix) <- surgery_types
#Fitted values by surgery type
fitted_trans_surg <- predict(random_trans_surg, newmods = surgery_types_matrix, addx = TRUE)

```

### Subgroup plot

``` {r}
#Increase the left margin to allow the type of surgery labels to fit
par(mar = c(5.1, 10, 4.1, 2.1))
#Set up the plot area
plot(NA, NA, xlim = c(-6, 2), ylim = c(0.5, length(surgery_types) + 0.5), xlab = "Mean & 95% Confidence / Prediction Interval",
ylab = "", xaxt = "n", yaxt = "n",
main = "Odds ratio of transfusion\nby type of surgery")
#Add mean and CI for each type of surgery
for (surg in surgery_types) {
lines(x = c(fitted_trans_surg$pi.lb[fitted_trans_surg$slab == surg],
fitted_trans_surg$pi.ub[fitted_trans_surg$slab == surg]),
y = rep(which(surg == surgery_types), times = 2), lty="dashed")
```

# Redo meta-regression in JAGS to account for shared error in baseline risk

``` {r}
library(R2jags)

df <- TBLDataFull

# excluding missing values
 df <- df[!is.na(df$SD.1) & !is.na(df$SD.2), ]

# Impute SDs using coefficient of variation from trials with data
# cv1 <- with(df, sum(SD.1, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(Mean.1[!is.na(SD.1)]))
# cv2 <- with(df, sum(SD.2,   na.rm = TRUE) / sum(Mean.2[!is.na(SD.2)]))
# 
# df$SD.1[is.na(df$SD.1)] <- cv1 * df$Mean.1[is.na(df$SD.1)]
# df$SD.2[is.na(df$SD.2)]     <- cv2 * df$Mean.2[is.na(df$SD.2)]

dat <- list(
  ns    = nrow(df),
  mean1 = df$Mean.1,
  mean2 = df$Mean.2,
  sd1   = df$SD.1,
  sd2   = df$SD.2,
  n1    = df$N.1,
  n2    = df$N.2,
  mx    = mean(df$Mean.1)      # centering value
)

inits <- function() list(
  d = 0, beta = 0, m = mean(df$Mean.1), sdmu = sd(df$Mean.1),
  U = 1, V = 1,
  mu = df$Mean.1
)

fit <- jags(
  data = dat, inits = inits,
  parameters.to.save = c("d", "beta", "sigma", "prop0", "m", "sdmu", "mu"),
  model.file = "md_RE_BR_model.txt",
  n.chains = 3, n.iter = 50000, n.burnin = 10000, n.thin = 5
)

print(fit)                       # check Rhat < 1.05 and decent n.eff
traceplot(fit, varname = c("d", "beta", "sigma"))


sims  <- fit$BUGSoutput$sims.list
beta  <- sims$beta         
d     <- sims$d
mx    <- mean(df$Mean.1)

quantile(beta, c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975))

# 2. Line and 95% credible band over a grid of baseline values
xgrid <- seq(min(df$Mean.1), max(df$Mean.1), length.out = 100)

eff      <- sapply(xgrid, function(x) d + beta * (x - mx))   # treatment - control
eff_med  <- apply(eff, 2, median)
eff_low  <- apply(eff, 2, quantile, 0.025)
eff_high <- apply(eff, 2, quantile, 0.975)

plot(TBLDataFull$Mean.1, TBLDataFull$MD, pch = Ortho, cex = size, col=c(rep("black",55),rep("blue",39)),
     xlab = "Blood Loss in Control Arm (ml)", ylab = "TXA Blood Loss - Control Blood Loss (ml)",
     las = 1, bty = "l", main = "Regression of Difference in Blood Loss between \n Trial arms and Blood Loss in the Control Arm ", ylim = c(-1000,300))
#lines(0:1200, preds$pred)
#lines(0:1200, preds$ci.lb, lty = "dashed")
#lines(0:1200, preds$ci.ub, lty = "dashed")
#lines(0:2500, preds2$pred, col="blue")
#lines(0:2500, preds2$ci.lb, lty = "dashed", col="blue")
#lines(0:2500, preds2$ci.ub, lty = "dashed", col="blue")
lines(xgrid, eff_med, col = "red", lwd = 2)
abline(h = 1, lty = "dotted")

legend("topright", legend = c("Low risk trials", "High risk trials", "Overall regression line"),
       col = c("black", "blue", "red"),
       pch = c(1,2,NA),
       lty = c(NA,NA,1))
```

```{r LoS}

# Subset data so we only have length of stay information, pick relevant columns, remove any data w/ missing info
LosData_subset <- subset(LowRiskAllOutcomes, !is.na(los.mean1))
LosData_subset <- LosData_subset[,c("X", "Study", "covar.Surg", "covar.Route","T.1", "los.mean1", "los.sd1", "los.n1", "T.2","los.mean2", "los.sd2", "los.n2")]
LosData_subset <- subset(LosData_subset, !is.na(los.sd1) # hamedani_2021 removed because has NA for SD
                         & los.sd1 != 0.1 # comment for sensitivity analysis
)
LosData_subset <- LosData_subset[LosData_subset$Study != "Pacheco_2023", ]

# Mean Difference and standard error 
LosData_subset$MD <- LosData_subset$los.mean2 - LosData_subset$los.mean1
LosData_subset$seMD <- sqrt((LosData_subset$los.sd1^2)/LosData_subset$los.n1 + (LosData_subset$los.sd2^2)/LosData_subset$los.n2)

LosData_subset <- LosData_subset[-1,]

# fixed and random effects models
fixedLOS_subset<- rma(yi=MD, sei=seMD, data=LosData_subset, method='FE')
fixedLOS_subset

randomLOS_subset<-rma(yi=MD, sei=seMD, data=LosData_subset)
randomLOS_subset


# Prepare data to round SD values for better display

LosData_subset$los.sd2 <- round(LosData_subset$los.sd2, 2)

# Forest plot

)

# Add headers for the table columns

     max(as.numeric(fixedLOS_subset$slab)) + 1.5,                                  # Position headers above the plot

# Add headers for treatment and control columns

text(9, max(as.numeric(fixedLOS_subset$slab)) + 1.5, "Mean Difference [95% CI]", pos = 2, cex = 0.75)

# Add fixed and random effects estimate
abline(h=0)
addpoly.rma(fixedLOS_subset, row=-2, mlab = "FE Model", addpred=TRUE)
addpoly.rma(randomLOS_subset, row=-1, mlab = "RE Model", addpred=TRUE)
```

# Thrombosis

## Forest Plot 

```{r}
# Contunuity Correction 
#Row index for trials with outcomes of 0 in either arm
zero_index <- which(ThrombData$R.1 == 0 | ThrombData$R.2 == 0)
#Display the trials to add a continuity correction to
ThrombData$Study[zero_index]
#Add 0.5 to numerator and denominator in both arms
ThrombData$R.1[zero_index] <- ThrombData$R.1[zero_index] + 0.5
ThrombData$R.2[zero_index] <- ThrombData$R.2[zero_index] + 0.5
ThrombData$N.1[zero_index] <- ThrombData$N.1[zero_index] + 0.5
ThrombData$N.2[zero_index] <- ThrombData$N.2[zero_index] + 0.5

# Calculate the log odds ratio (logor)
ThrombData$logor = log( (ThrombData$R.2 / (ThrombData$N.2 - ThrombData$R.2)) / (ThrombData$R.1 / (ThrombData$N.1 - ThrombData$R.1)) )

# Calculate the standard error of the log odds ratio (selogor)
ThrombData$selogor = sqrt((1 / ThrombData$R.1) + 
                          (1 / (ThrombData$N.1 - ThrombData$R.1)) + 
                          (1 / ThrombData$R.2) + 
                          (1 / (ThrombData$N.2 - ThrombData$R.2)))


# calculate 2x2 cell data
ThrombData$a = ThrombData$R.2
ThrombData$b = ThrombData$N.2 - ThrombData$R.2
ThrombData$c = ThrombData$R.1
ThrombData$d = ThrombData$N.1 - ThrombData$R.1

# Fixed and random effects 
fixedThrom <- rma(ai=a, bi=b, ci=c, di=d, measure="OR", method="FE", data=ThrombData)
randomThrom <- rma(ai=a, bi=b, ci=c, di=d, measure="OR", method = "REML", data=ThrombData)

ThrombData2 <- ThrombData
ThrombData2$R.1[c(2,3)] <- ThrombData$R.1[c(2,3)] - 0.5
ThrombData2$R.2[c(2,3)] <- ThrombData$R.2[c(2,3)] - 0.5

# Forest plot
forest(randomThrom, 
       slab = paste(ThrombData$Study),
       xlim = c(-27, 10), 
       at = log(c(0.01, 0.25, 1, 10)), 
       atransf = exp, 
       ilab = cbind(ThrombData2$R.2, ThrombData2$b, ThrombData2$R.1, ThrombData2$d), 
       ilab.xpos = c(-19, -15, -11, -7), 
       cex=0.7,
       header = FALSE,
       addpred=TRUE,
       main = "Forest Plot of Deep Vein Thrombosis Meta-Analysis")
text(c(-19, -15, -11, -7), 4.5, c("Thrombosis", "No Thrombosis", "Thrombosis", "No Thrombosis"), cex = 0.75)
text(c(-17, -9), 5, c("TXA", "Placebo"), cex = 0.75)
text(-27, 4.5, "Study ID", pos = 4, cex = 0.75)
text(10, 4.5, "Odds Ratio [95% CI]", pos = 2, cex = 0.75)
addpoly(fixedThrom, row = -0.5, cex = 0.75, atransf = exp, addpred=TRUE)


```

# Pain

## Data Set-up
```{r Read in Data and Manipulate, message=FALSE}
# Load in the data 
library(readxl)
library(metafor)
library(ggplot2)

pain <- read_excel("pain.xlsx")

# Extract Data of Study that needs two TXA groups combining  
N1 <- pain$TXA_n_01[pain$Study == "Ma 2021"]
N2 <- pain$TXA_n_02[pain$Study == "Ma 2021"]
Mean1 <- pain$TXA_mean_01[pain$Study == "Ma 2021"]
Mean2 <- pain$TXA_mean_02[pain$Study == "Ma 2021"]
SD1 <- pain$TXA_sd_01[pain$Study == "Ma 2021"]
SD2 <- pain$TXA_sd_02[pain$Study == "Ma 2021"]

# Overwrite the TXA arm column with new, combined data for... 
# Mean 
pain$TXA_mean_01[pain$Study == "Ma 2021"] <- ((N1 * Mean1) + (N2 * Mean2)) / 
  (N1 + N2)

# SD 
pain$TXA_sd_01[pain$Study == "Ma 2021"] <- sqrt( 
  (N1 - 1)*(SD1)^2 + (N2 - 1)*(SD2)^2 + ((N1 * N2) / (N1 + N2)) * 
    ((Mean1)^2 + (Mean2)^2 - (2 * Mean1 * Mean2)))  / (N1 + N2 - 1)

# Sample size 
pain$TXA_n_01[pain$Study == "Ma 2021"] <- N1 + N2

# Remove third Arm and clear R enviroment 
pain$TXA_mean_02 <- pain$TXA_sd_02 <- pain$TXA_n_02 <- NULL
rm(Mean1, Mean2, N1, N2, SD1, SD2)

# Mean Difference = TXA - Control, and Se of Mean Difference
pain$MD <- pain$TXA_mean_01 - pain$Control_mean
pain$seMD <- sqrt((pain$Control_sd^2)/pain$Control_n + (pain$TXA_sd_01^2)/pain$TXA_n_01)

# Prepare data to round SD values for better display
pain$Control_sd <- round(pain$Control_sd, 2)
pain$TXA_sd_01 <- round(pain$TXA_sd_01, 2)

# Calculate study weights for point size (used later for regression plot)
pain$wi <- 1 / (pain$seMD^2)
pain$size <- 0.5 + 3 * (pain$wi - min(pain$wi, na.rm = TRUE)) / (max(pain$wi, na.rm = TRUE) - min(pain$wi, na.rm = TRUE))

# Subset the data at each time point 
pain1to3 <- subset(pain, Post_op_day == "Day 1-3")
pain1to3
painw1 <- subset(pain, Post_op_day == "Week 1")
painw1
painw2 <- subset(pain, Post_op_day == "Week 2")
painw2
painw3to6 <- subset(pain, Post_op_day == "Week 3-6")
painw3to6

```

```{r Forest Plot}

create_forest_plot <- function(random_model, fixed_model, pain_data, xlim, ylim, cex, main_title) {
  
  # Generate the forest plot
  forest(random_model, 
         slab = paste(pain_data$Study),       
         xlim = xlim,                     
         ylim = ylim,
         addpred=TRUE,
         header = FALSE,
         ilab = cbind(pain_data$TXA_mean_01, 
                      pain_data$TXA_sd_01, 
                      pain_data$TXA_n_01,  
                      pain_data$Control_mean, 
                      pain_data$Control_sd, 
                      pain_data$Control_n), # Add Mean, SD, N for each group
         ilab.xpos = seq(-16, -6, length.out = 6), 
         cex = cex,                                                         
         main = main_title                                                  
  )
  
  # Add headers for the table columns
  text(seq(-16, -6, length.out = 6), 
       max(as.numeric(fixed_model$slab)) + 1.5,                              
       # Position headers above the plot
       c("Mean", "SD", "N", "Mean", "SD", "N"), 
       cex = cex)
  
  # Add headers for treatment and control columns
  text(seq(-16, -6, length.out = 6)[c(2, 5)], 
       max(as.numeric(fixed_model$slab)) + 2,                              
       # Position headers above the plot
       c("TXA", "Placebo"), 
       cex = cex)
  
  # Add Study ID and Mean Difference headers
  text(-25, max(as.numeric(fixed_model$slab)) + 1.5, "Study ID", pos = 4, cex = cex)
  text(10, max(as.numeric(fixed_model$slab)) + 1.5, "Mean Difference [95% CI]", pos = 2, cex = cex)
  
  # Add fixed effects estimate
  addpoly.rma(fixed_model, addpred=TRUE)
}

# Example usage
create_forest_plot(random1to3, fixed1to3, pain1to3, 
                   xlim = c(-25, 10), ylim = c(-3, 17), cex = 0.8, 
                   main_title = "Forest Plot: VAS Scores (Post-op Day 1 to 3)")

create_forest_plot(randomw1, fixedw1, painw1, 
                   xlim = c(-25, 10), ylim = c(-3, 12), cex = 0.8, 
                   main_title = "Forest Plot: VAS Scores (Post-op Week 1)")

create_forest_plot(randomw2, fixedw2, painw2, 
                   xlim = c(-25, 10), ylim = c(-3, 9), cex = 0.8, 
                   main_title = "Forest Plot: VAS Scores (Post-op Week 2)")

create_forest_plot(randomw3to6, fixedw3to6, painw3to6, 
                   xlim = c(-25, 10), ylim = c(-3, 13), cex = 0.8, 
                   main_title = "Forest Plot: VAS Scores (Post-op Week 3 to 6)")
```

```{r Funnel Plot at each time point}
)
```
